# ECG Productions

> > Atlanta-based video production company specializing in commercials, brand storytelling, book trailers, and corporate videos for clients like James Patterson, Children's Healthcare of Atlanta, P&G, and the U.S. EPA.

ECG Productions is led by industry professionals including Emily Payton, Cameron Shaw, Jason Sirotin, and Trey Gregory. The company offers full-service video production from concept through post-production, with expertise in animation, color grading, and short-form content for both traditional and digital platforms.
